-- Module:WeeklyTokens
-- The weekly Activity Token quests of Template:WeeklyTokens: one box per day, the quests of that day and the tokens they give.
-- The days run 00:00 - 23:59 server time (America/New_York). The script in MediaWiki:Common.js highlights the day that is
-- active and counts down to the next one; without the script the boxes are just a plain list.
-- To change something, edit DAYS below: dow is the weekday (Mon = 0 ... Sun = 6), quests are { name, page to link to, tokens }.
local p = {}

local SERVER = 'America/New_York'
local ICON = 'Activity Token.png'      -- File:Activity Token.png (item 8001120)
local ICON_PAGE = 'Activity Tokens'

local DAYS = {
	{ dow = 4, name = 'Friday', quests = {
		{ 'The Crystalline Bloodbath', 'Crystalline Bloodbath', 30 },
	} },
	{ dow = 5, name = 'Saturday', quests = {
		{ 'Preparing for the Fish Market', 'Fishing quest', 20 },
		{ 'Have You Ever Seen A Ghost?', 'Delphinad Ghost Ship', 33 },
		{ 'Guardians of the Library', 'Ayanad Library', 10 },
		{ 'Guardians of the Library 2', 'Ayanad Library', 10 },
	} },
	{ dow = 6, name = 'Sunday', quests = {
		{ 'The Crimson Threat', 'Anthalon', 33 },
	}, note = 'To unlock this quest, first finish the custom story quests (Chapter 99): kill the Hounds of Kyrios, then Anthalon.' },
}

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

local function tokens(n)
	local t = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('wkq-tok')
	t:wikitext('[[File:' .. ICON .. '|20px|link=' .. ICON_PAGE .. '|alt=Activity Tokens]]')
	t:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-n'):wikitext(tostring(n))
	return t
end

function p.main(frame)
	local args = frame and frame.args or {}
	local mini = args.mini ~= nil and args.mini ~= '' and args.mini ~= 'no'
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('wkq'):attr('data-zone', SERVER)
	if mini then root:addClass('wkq-mini') end

	local top = root:tag('div'):addClass('wkq-top')
	top:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-title'):wikitext(mini and '[[' .. ICON_PAGE .. '|Weekly Tokens]]' or 'Weekly [[' .. ICON_PAGE .. '|Activity Token]] quests')
	top:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-next')
	root:tag('div'):addClass('wkq-sub'):wikitext('Each day lasts from 00:00 to 23:59 server time (New York). The quests can be finished any time during the week.')

	local boxes = root:tag('div'):addClass('wkq-boxes')
	for _, d in ipairs(DAYS) do
		local box = boxes:tag('div'):addClass('wkq-day'):attr('data-dow', d.dow):attr('data-name', d.name)
		local head = box:tag('div'):addClass('wkq-dayhead')
		local dn = head:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-dayname')
		dn:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-full'):wikitext(d.name)
		dn:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-abbr'):wikitext(string.sub(d.name, 1, 3))
		if #d.quests == 1 then box:addClass('wkq-single') end
		head:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-state')
		local list = box:tag('ul'):addClass('wkq-list')
		local total = 0
		for _, q in ipairs(d.quests) do
			total = total + q[3]
			local li = list:tag('li'):addClass('wkq-q'):attr('title', q[1] .. ' - ' .. q[3] .. ' Activity Tokens')
			li:tag('span'):addClass('wkq-qname'):wikitext('[[' .. q[2] .. '|' .. esc(q[1]) .. ']]')
			li:node(tokens(q[3]))
		end
		if #d.quests > 1 then
			local foot = box:tag('div'):addClass('wkq-foot')
			foot:tag('span'):wikitext('Total')
			foot:node(tokens(total))
		end
		if d.note then box:tag('div'):addClass('wkq-note'):wikitext(esc(d.note)) end
	end
	return tostring(root)
end

return p
